dialogues.speaker: Pochtli
dialogues.text: You were really throwing some shapes up on that stage! I've never seen someone dance with such power before... It was epic! Can you show us again?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Joints cooling... Please try again later...

dialogues.speaker: Tano
dialogues.text: Was that... "the robot"? I thought that dance was the stuff of legends...

dialogues.speaker: Tano
dialogues.text: That timbre sounds pretty good! I'm assuming his turntabling skills have become even better?

dialogues.speaker: Pochtli
dialogues.text: His turntabling skills have always been pretty good, but this time, I think the credit has got to go to the new record-pressing technique.

dialogues.speaker: Tano
dialogues.text: Ohh, you mean what we talked about last time regarding the new liquid phlogiston method! You've already managed to make it work?

dialogues.speaker: Tano
dialogues.text: Oh, never! I'm just really happy for you.

dialogues.speaker: Pochtli
dialogues.text: It's still in the experimental phase. I'm still gathering feedback even as I watch the show.

dialogues.speaker: Pochtli
dialogues.text: Hmm... Sounds like it's pretty difficult to control the movement of the record when you're trying to scratch it...

dialogues.speaker: Pochtli
dialogues.text: Seems like there's still room for improvement.
